environment.description: Application deployed on EC2 behind the same ALB configuration, but the ALB is associated with an AWS WAFv2 WebACL. The WebACL contains two rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) Priority 100 - AWS Managed Rule Group 'AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet' with SizeRestriction_QUERYSTRING rule set to COUNT (not BLOCK) and all other rules at default action, (2) Priority 200 - AWS Managed Rule Group 'AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet' with all rules at default action (BLOCK). The WebACL default action is ALLOW. Additionally, the EC2 instance IAM role has a permissions boundary attached (arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:policy/DataAccessBoundary) that denies s3:GetObject on all buckets - this is unrelated to the SQL injection but present for data exfiltration prevention. CloudTrail is enabled with data events logging.
